name: milestones
title: Milestones
description: The rewards that sit on a progress track: the ones reached, the one being worked towards, and the ones still locked. The track is a real `progress-bar` rather than a second bar written here, so there is one fill geometry and one set of state words; BDS-022 makes `progress-bar` the base for this component for that reason, and the nested bar keeps its own root marker so a test can tell composition from reimplementation. Each marker rides on `data-gs-milestone` and carries its state as `data-gs-complete`, `data-gs-active` or `data-gs-locked`, never as a colour: a reached one shows a tick, a locked one a padlock, and the current one is larger as well as brighter. There is no `data-gs-progress` and no `data-gs-fill`; a marker's position is a custom property, which is not an attribute. Performs nothing: it never decides a milestone is reached, unlocks one, or claims a reward.
docs: Pass `value`, `max` and optionally `min` for the track, and `milestones` for what sits on it. A milestone's position comes from its `at`, in the same units as the value, not from its place in the array. Pass `complete`, `active` or `locked` per milestone: the component never works out that a milestone is reached from the value passing it, because the host owns that decision and a reward the host has not settled must not look settled. Pass `children` on a milestone for what rides inside the marker, such as a multiplier. It imports `./progress-bar`, which is the flat path a `gamestage-ui add` produces, and `@gamestage/progress-bar` is what puts the file there.
